title: California Outdoor, Vehicle & Personal Safety
description: Stay safe in the community, on the road, and while visiting clients.

steps.title: Outdoor, Vehicle & Personal Safety
steps.content:
OUTDOOR SAFETY
- Scan the area before approaching the home.
- Park in well-lit, visible spots when possible.
- Have your visit bag ready and keep one arm free.
- Walk directly to the residence in a businesslike manner.
- Trust your instincts; leave and call the office if you feel unsafe.

VEHICLE SAFETY
- Keep your vehicle in good working order with enough fuel.
- Do not transport clients in your personal vehicle unless the agency and client have given written consent.
- Keep a valid driver's license and insurance if driving is required.
- Lock your car when parked or driving.
- Turn on emergency flashers and wait for police if you have car trouble.

PERSONAL SAFETY
- Wear non-slip, closed-toe shoes.
- Wear your ID badge and professional attire.
- Keep your phone charged and available for emergencies.
- Avoid carrying purses or valuables into the home.
- Report aggressive behavior, threats, animal bites, or unsafe situations to the office immediately.
